ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERNAMEPREFIX_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix AS(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId,CustomerNameId ORDER BY INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
	SELECT
		BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
		,HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(BCM.CUST_FIRST_NAME, BCM.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME,BCM.CUST_LAST_NAME)) AS CustomerNameId
		,BCM.CUST_TITLE AS NamePrefixId
		,NULL AS PrefixOrderNumber
		,NULL AS CustomerNameprefixNote
		,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCMD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCMD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM ON BCMD.CUST_NBR = BCM.CUST_NBR AND BCMD.CUST_STATUS = BCM.CUST_STATUS AND BCM.isLatest = '1'

	UNION
	
	SELECT
		BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
		,HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(BCD.CUST_FIRST_NAME, BCD.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME,BCD.CUST_LAST_NAME)) AS CustomerNameId
		,BCD.CUST_TITLE AS NamePrefixId
		,NULL AS PrefixOrderNumber
		,NULL AS CustomerNameprefixNote
		,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCDD.CUST_NBR = BCD.CUST_NBR AND BCDD.CUST_STATUS = BCD.CUST_STATUS AND BCD.isLatest = '1'
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix WHERE RN = 1;


WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		CustomerId
		,CustomerNameId
		,NamePrefixId
		)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerId
		,RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix
    WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		CustomerId
		,CustomerNameId
		,NamePrefixId
		)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerNamePrefix
	WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT 
SET

[CustomerId] = SRC.CustomerId
,[CustomerNameId] = SRC.CustomerNameId
,[NamePrefixId] = SRC.NamePrefixId
,[PrefixOrderNumber] = NULL
,[CustomerNamePrefixNote] = NULL
,[SourceSystemCode] = 'CCD'
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerNamePrefix TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId ;


INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerNamePrefix (
	[CustomerId]
	,[CustomerNameId]
	,[NamePrefixId]
	,[PrefixOrderNumber]
	,[CustomerNamePrefixNote]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[CustomerId]
	,[CustomerNameId]
	,[NamePrefixId]
	,[PrefixOrderNumber]
	,[CustomerNamePrefixNote]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,'CCD' AS [SourceSystemCode]
	,0 AS [TaskRunId]
	,0 AS [WorkFlowId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerNamePrefix_DELTA;

END
